dict.string: Anticipy connects to your pendant over Bluetooth. When it is connected, pendant audio is sent to Deepgram for live transcription. Only needed if you have a pendant.

Anticipy reads what is coming up in the next month — the title and the time, nothing else — so she knows what you already have on. She never reads the notes or the invitees, and never puts anything in your calendar unless you ask her to.

Anticipy reads the names in your contacts so she knows who you mean when you say one. She never reads a number, an email or an address, and never messages anyone on her own.

Anticipy listens through your microphone, including while the app is in the background, so she can catch what you commit to. Audio stays on your phone; the words are sent to Anticipy's server so she can act on them. You control when she is listening.
Anticipy turns what she hears into text on your phone, then sends that text to her server so she can remember it and act on it.
